description: List all candidates in the Greenhouse session.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of candidate objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single candidate by its id.

candidate_id.description: The unique id of the candidate.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the candidate object; on failure (candidate not found), output contains an error message.

source.description: Optional sourcing channel; defaults to 'API' when omitted.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created candidate object; on failure (missing required fields), output contains an error message.

description: List jobs, optionally filtered by status.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of job objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single job by its id.

job_id.description: The unique id of the job.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the job object; on failure (job not found), output contains an error message.

description: List applications, optionally filtered by job, candidate, and status.

job_id.description: Optional job id to filter applications by.

candidate_id.description: Optional candidate id to filter applications by.

status.description: Optional application status to filter by (e.g. 'active', 'rejected', 'hired').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of application objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single application by its id.

application_id.description: The unique id of the application.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the application object; on failure (application not found), output contains an error message.

description: Advance an active application to the next pipeline stage (Application Review -> Interview -> Offer -> Hired).

application_id.description: The unique id of the application to advance.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated application object; on failure (application not found or not active), output contains an error message.

description: Reject an application, optionally recording a rejection reason.

application_id.description: The unique id of the application to reject.

reason.description: Optional rejection reason; defaults to 'Not a fit' when omitted.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated application object; on failure (application not found), output contains an error message.

description: List interview scorecards, optionally filtered by application and candidate.

application_id.description: Optional application id to filter scorecards by.

candidate_id.description: Optional candidate id to filter scorecards by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of scorecard objects; on failure, output contains an error message.
